caption: The image shows a ceramic pitcher with a single handle, decorated with black illustrations and motifs on a white background. On the left side of the pitcher, there is a prominent oval-shaped frame containing a portrait of a man in profile, seated next to a woman; above them is an eagle with outstretched wings clutching arrows and an olive branch, and surrounding the frame are stars and patterned borders. To the right of the portrait, there is an ornate laurel or floral wreath encircling the text "SAMUEL BRINTNALL." Various smaller floral motifs and decorative patterns are dispersed around the surface, including single flowers and leaves. Near the bottom right, there is a heraldic bird, possibly a rooster, standing with one raised leg and surrounded by foliage, all rendered in the same black illustrative style. The rim and the base have repeating decorative borders and patterns. The overall composition is symmetrical and emphasizes ornamental and representational design elements in contrasting black on a light-colored pottery surface.
title: Liverpool Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
